title: Impact of Remote Exercise on Sleep in PD
official: Proof of Concept Study: Evaluating the Effects of Remote High-Intensity Resistance Exercise on Sleep Quality in Parkinson's Disease
summary: The purpose of this study is to see the impact of 12 weeks of remote resistance exercise on remotely measured sleep quality for people with Parkinson's Disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease
* Has strong internet access at home
* Has experience with the Zoom platform
* Has a study partner at home that can be present throughout the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncontrolled medical conditions
* Exercising more than 5 days a week for at or more than moderate level intensity

sites.f: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
